abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes 30% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: 1.5 seconds after cast, a series of 10 pulses separated by 0.1 seconds deal the damage.
notes.note1: Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
notes.note2: You can't kill yourself with this skill.
notes.note3: The pulses stop if Slark dies.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.

notes.note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of 933.33, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled 700 distance.
notes.note1: Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
notes.note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

abilities.name: Saltwater Shiv
abilities.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

abilities.name: Depth Shroud
abilities.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

abilities.name: Essence Shift
abilities.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.

notes.note1: Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
notes.note2: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
notes.note3: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
notes.note4: Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

abilities.name: Shadow Dance
abilities.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for 2.0 seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

abilities.name: Fortune's End
abilities.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: Fate's Edict
abilities.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.

abilities.name: Purifying Flames
abilities.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.

notes.note0: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
notes.note1: The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

abilities.name: Rain of Destiny
abilities.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.

abilities.name: False Promise
abilities.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

notes.note0: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
notes.note1: The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

abilities.name: Berserker's Call
abilities.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

abilities.name: Battle Hunger
abilities.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

notes.note0: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.

abilities.name: Counter Helix
abilities.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

notes.note0: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
notes.note1: Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.

abilities.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: Culling Blade
abilities.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

notes.note0: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: One Man Army
abilities.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe.  The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

abilities.name: Fatal Bonds
abilities.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.

notes.note0: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
notes.note1: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: Shadow Word
abilities.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10/12/14/16 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1.0 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.

notes.note0: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

abilities.shard: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

abilities.name: Eldritch Summoning
abilities.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

notes.note0: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.

abilities.name: Chaotic Offering
abilities.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.

notes.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: Static Remnant
abilities.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for 12.0 seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.

notes.note0: Remnants take 0.75 second to materialize after the spell is cast.
notes.note1: Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
notes.note2: The explosion actually hits units in a 300 radius, but will only be triggered in 235.
notes.note3: Can be self-cast to cast in place.

abilities.name: Electric Vortex
abilities.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
abilities.scepter: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
abilities.shard: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes  Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to  seconds or until the charges are depleted.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is 25+7.5% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is 10+0.65% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

notes.note0: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
notes.note2: Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

abilities.name: Galvanized
abilities.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

notes.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.
